يقتبسون (form VIII)
# يَقْتَبِسُونَ (yaqtabisūna) /jaq.ta.bi.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# يُقْتَبَسُونَ (yuqtabasūna) /juq.ta.ba.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
